title: 三种 GC 算法对比：碎片、移动次数与空间浪费
expected_output:
before GC       : ######.##..##   live=9 holes=2
mark-sweep      : ######.##..#   live=9 moves=0 holes=2
mark-compact    : #########...   live=9 moves=3 holes=1
copy(2 halves)  : half=6 liveInFirstHalf=6 -> wasteful if semispace not full
copy moves = live count   : 9 (every live object moves)
trade-off: sweep keeps holes, compact moves but is fragment-free, copy wastes half the space
